model.name: 1D depth-averaged shallow-water debris-flow scenario
model.status: un calibrated exploratory dynamics; post-inlet channel propagation only
model.time_origin: relative seconds after assumed channel-entry hydrograph begins; calendar entry time unknown
model.centerline_source: geo-pera Bhote Koshi 2026 reconstruction v1.1; CC BY-NC 4.0; attribution required
model.centerline_crs_evidence: Existing event-context preparation identifies the CSV coordinates as EPSG:32645
model.input_dem: data/西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害（20260826）DEM8m数据/DongLinZangBu_basin_HMA8mDEM_fillAW3D30.tif
model.input_dem_note: The HMA 8 m DEM is sampled after transforming the EPSG:32645 centerline coordinates to its GeoTIFF CRS; zero, NoData and out-of-raster route samples are rejected rather than replaced.
model.route_elevation_source: DongLinZangBu_basin_HMA8mDEM_fillAW3D30.tif nearest-cell samples every 25 m along the geo-pera centerline; the vertical datum and effective source resolution are not documented in this project copy
model.inlet_definition: A/B source-point nearest centerline chainage is the model inlet. Hillslope descent from the 5200 m source region to this inlet is excluded.
unmodeled_processes: ice-rock avalanche from source points to channel inlet
debris-flow phase transition and water/sediment mixing
erosion, entrainment, deposition, lateral spreading, tributary inflow

numerics.bed_filter: none; nearest-cell HMA DEM samples at 25 m are retained without smoothing; local uphill segments and steep jumps are reported as an input limitation

inlet_depth_m.source_or_basis: No local flow-depth observation; selected as a computational scenario. A separate Alpine case study reported average depth about 2 m, which is context only and not a local transfer.

pulse_duration_s.source_or_basis: No local inlet hydrograph or channel-entry duration is available; rectangular pulse is a transparent boundary scenario. Not tied to the reported 10:54:19–10:55:10 transition window.

volume_m3.evidence_grade: exploratory assumption; no local source or channelized volume measured
volume_m3.source_or_basis: Reference volume and half/double perturbations are scenario inputs only. A published 60,000 m3 Alpine event is not a local prior and is not used as a measured value.

channel_width_m.source_or_basis: Constant rectangular-equivalent width chosen only for sensitivity scenarios; not measured from imagery or a cross-section.

voellmy_mu.evidence_grade: literature-grounded candidate scenarios; not calibrated locally
voellmy_mu.source_or_basis: An ESurf 2025 case used mu=0.1 as an illustrative Voellmy scenario and derived mu=0.249 for a separately calibrated Alpine case. This project explores lower-to-higher values without transferring that case as local truth.

voellmy_xi_m_s2.evidence_grade: literature-grounded candidate scenarios; not calibrated locally
voellmy_xi_m_s2.source_or_basis: The same ESurf 2025 paper uses xi=1000 m s-2 in an illustrative case and estimates xi about 52 m s-2 for its instrumented Alpine event. 300 is an intermediate exploration value, not a reported measurement.

external_timing_evidence.use: comparison-only external timeline; not a boundary-condition time, calibration target, or independent validation label
